learning_outcomes.text: Possesses a sufficient background in mathematics, basic sciences, and engineering subjects related to their field; uses theoretical and applied knowledge in these areas together for Electrical-Electronics Engineering solutions.
Identifies, defines, formulates, and solves Electrical-Electronics Engineering problems; selects and applies appropriate analytical methods and modeling techniques for this purpose.
Analyzes and designs a system, system component, or process to meet desired requirements under realistic constraints; applies modern design methods in this regard.
Selects and uses modern techniques and tools necessary for engineering applications; effectively uses information technologies and at least one computer software.
Designs experiments, conducts experiments, collects data, analyzes and interprets results.
Accesses information and conducts resource research for this purpose, uses databases and other information sources.
Works effectively individually and in multidisciplinary teams, takes responsibility.
Communicates effectively orally and in writing in Turkish; has knowledge of at least one foreign language at the B1 general level of the European Language Portfolio.
Is aware of the necessity of lifelong learning; monitors developments in science and technology and continuously renews themselves.
Has a sense of professional and ethical responsibility.

syllabus_topics: Importance of energy and electrical energy. World and our country's situation in terms of primary and renewable energy sources.
Methods of Obtaining Electrical Energy. Power Plants, types of power plants used in electricity generation.
Coal-fired thermal power plants. Steam turbines. Classification of steam turbines. Gas turbine combined cycle power plants.
Hydroelectric power plants. Diesel and nuclear power plants.
Equipment used in Electrical Energy Production.
Equipment used in Electrical Energy Production.
Equipment used in Electrical Energy Production.
Synchronous generators used in power plants.
Synchronous generators used in power plants.
Conditions for parallel connection in synchronous generators.
